conversation_channels_one_conv_check.name: conversation_channels_one_conv_check
conversation_channels_one_conv_check.value:
("conversationType" = 'chat' AND "chatConversationId" IS NOT NULL AND "agencyConversationId" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("conversationType" = 'agency' AND "agencyConversationId" IS NOT NULL AND "chatConversationId" IS NULL)

emergency_assignments_active_need_respon.name: emergency_assignments_active_need_responder_unique
emergency_assignments_active_need_respon.where: "emergency_assignments"."taskId" IS NULL AND "emergency_assignments"."needId" IS NOT NULL AND "emergency_assignments"."status" IN ('offered', 'accepted', 'en_route', 'working')

emergency_hydro_observation_missing_qual.name: emergency_hydro_observation_missing_quality_check
emergency_hydro_observation_missing_qual.value: "emergency_hydro_observations"."qualityCode" <> 'missing' OR ("emergency_hydro_observations"."rawValue" IS NULL AND "emergency_hydro_observations"."normalizedValue" IS NULL)

emergency_legal_hold_release_check.name: emergency_legal_hold_release_check
emergency_legal_hold_release_check.value: ("emergency_legal_holds"."status" = 'active' AND "emergency_legal_holds"."releasedAt" IS NULL AND "emergency_legal_holds"."releasedByUserId" IS NULL AND "emergency_legal_holds"."releaseReason" IS NULL) OR ("emergency_legal_holds"."status" = 'released' AND "emergency_legal_holds"."releasedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "emergency_legal_holds"."releasedByUserId" IS NOT NULL AND "emergency_legal_holds"."releaseReason" IS NOT NULL)

intelligence_evidence_scope_check.name: intelligence_evidence_scope_check
intelligence_evidence_scope_check.value: ("intelligence_evidence_items"."visibility" = 'public' AND "intelligence_evidence_items"."tenantId" IS NULL) OR ("intelligence_evidence_items"."visibility" = 'tenant' AND "intelligence_evidence_items"."tenantId" IS NOT NULL)

intelligence_research_request_scope_chec.name: intelligence_research_request_scope_check
intelligence_research_request_scope_chec.value: ("intelligence_research_requests"."authorizationScope" = 'PUBLIC' AND "intelligence_research_requests"."tenantId" IS NULL) OR ("intelligence_research_requests"."authorizationScope" = 'TENANT' AND "intelligence_research_requests"."tenantId" IS NOT NULL)

intelligence_source_scope_check.name: intelligence_source_scope_check
intelligence_source_scope_check.value: ("intelligence_sources"."visibility" = 'public' AND "intelligence_sources"."tenantId" IS NULL) OR ("intelligence_sources"."visibility" = 'tenant' AND "intelligence_sources"."tenantId" IS NOT NULL)

invoices_subscription_cycle_unique.name: invoices_subscription_cycle_unique
invoices_subscription_cycle_unique.where: "subscriptionId" IS NOT NULL AND "supersedesInvoiceId" IS NULL

llm_inference_attempts_state_consistency.name: llm_inference_attempts_state_consistency_check
llm_inference_attempts_state_consistency.value: ("llm_inference_attempts"."status" = 'prepared' AND "llm_inference_attempts"."submissionState" = 'not_submitted' AND "llm_inference_attempts"."outcome" IS NULL AND "llm_inference_attempts"."terminalAt" IS NULL) OR ("llm_inference_attempts"."status" = 'submitting' AND "llm_inference_attempts"."submissionState" = 'unknown' AND "llm_inference_attempts"."outcome" IS NULL AND "llm_inference_attempts"."terminalAt" IS NULL) OR ("llm_inference_attempts"."status" = 'submitted' AND "llm_inference_attempts"."submissionState" = 'submitted' AND "llm_inference_attempts"."outcome" IS NULL AND "llm_inference_attempts"."terminalAt" IS NULL) OR ("llm_inference_attempts"."status" = 'terminal' AND "llm_inference_attempts"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "llm_inference_attempts"."terminalAt" IS NOT NULL)

llm_inference_attempts_observed_identity.name: llm_inference_attempts_observed_identity_check
llm_inference_attempts_observed_identity.value: ("llm_inference_attempts"."observedProviderId" IS NULL AND "llm_inference_attempts"."observedCredentialOwnerRef" IS NULL AND "llm_inference_attempts"."observedDeploymentId" IS NULL AND "llm_inference_attempts"."observedEndpointSurface" IS NULL) OR ("llm_inference_attempts"."observedProviderId" IS NOT NULL AND "llm_inference_attempts"."observedCredentialOwnerRef" IS NOT NULL AND "llm_inference_attempts"."observedDeploymentId" IS NOT NULL AND "llm_inference_attempts"."observedEndpointSurface" IS NOT NULL AND "llm_inference_attempts"."observedEndpointSurface" IN ('native_responses', 'responses_compatible', 'chat_compatible', 'native_provider', 'local'))

llm_inference_chat_response_delivery_sta.name: llm_inference_chat_response_delivery_status_check
llm_inference_chat_response_delivery_sta.value: ("llm_inference_chat_response_deliveries"."status" = 'pending' AND "llm_inference_chat_response_deliveries"."content" IS NOT NULL) OR ("llm_inference_chat_response_deliveries"."status" = 'delivered' AND "llm_inference_chat_response_deliveries"."content" IS NULL)

llm_inference_policy_snapshot_scope_chec.name: llm_inference_policy_snapshot_scope_check
llm_inference_policy_snapshot_scope_chec.value: ("llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."scopeType" = 'platform' AND "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."scopeKey" = 'platform' AND "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."tenantId" IS NULL AND "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."principalRef" IS NULL) OR ("llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."scopeType" = 'tenant' AND "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."tenantId" IS NOT NULL AND "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."scopeKey" = "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."tenantId" AND "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."principalRef" IS NULL) OR ("llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."scopeType" = 'principal' AND "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."tenantId" IS NOT NULL AND "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."principalRef" IS NOT NULL AND "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."scopeKey" = "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."tenantId" || ':' || "llm_inference_policy_snapshots"."principalRef")

llm_inference_revocation_scope_check.name: llm_inference_revocation_scope_check
llm_inference_revocation_scope_check.value: ("llm_inference_revocations"."scopeType" = 'tenant' AND "llm_inference_revocations"."principalRef" IS NULL) OR ("llm_inference_revocations"."scopeType" = 'principal' AND "llm_inference_revocations"."principalRef" IS NOT NULL)

marketplace_capture_assets_dimensions_po.name: marketplace_capture_assets_dimensions_positive
marketplace_capture_assets_dimensions_po.value: ("marketplace_capture_assets"."width" IS NULL OR "marketplace_capture_assets"."width" > 0) AND ("marketplace_capture_assets"."height" IS NULL OR "marketplace_capture_assets"."height" > 0)

idx_marketplace_capture_sessions_user_so.name: idx_marketplace_capture_sessions_user_source_unique
idx_marketplace_capture_sessions_user_so.where: "externalProductId" IS NOT NULL AND "status" NOT IN ('confirmed', 'discarded')

idx_marketplace_capture_sessions_user_pr.name: idx_marketplace_capture_sessions_user_product_pair_unique
idx_marketplace_capture_sessions_user_pr.where: "externalShopId" IS NOT NULL AND "externalProductId" IS NOT NULL AND "status" NOT IN ('confirmed', 'discarded')

marketplace_product_images_dimensions_po.name: marketplace_product_images_dimensions_positive
marketplace_product_images_dimensions_po.value: ("marketplace_product_images"."width" IS NULL OR "marketplace_product_images"."width" > 0) AND ("marketplace_product_images"."height" IS NULL OR "marketplace_product_images"."height" > 0)

marketplace_price_snapshots_price_nonneg.name: marketplace_price_snapshots_price_nonnegative
marketplace_price_snapshots_price_nonneg.value: ("marketplace_product_price_snapshots"."priceCurrent" IS NULL OR "marketplace_product_price_snapshots"."priceCurrent" >= 0) AND ("marketplace_product_price_snapshots"."priceOriginal" IS NULL OR "marketplace_product_price_snapshots"."priceOriginal" >= 0)

idx_marketplace_products_user_product_pa.name: idx_marketplace_products_user_product_pair_unique
idx_marketplace_products_user_product_pa.where: "externalShopId" IS NOT NULL AND "externalProductId" IS NOT NULL

marketplace_products_price_nonnegative.name: marketplace_products_price_nonnegative
marketplace_products_price_nonnegative.value: ("marketplace_products"."priceCurrent" IS NULL OR "marketplace_products"."priceCurrent" >= 0) AND ("marketplace_products"."priceOriginal" IS NULL OR "marketplace_products"."priceOriginal" >= 0)

vdd_active_series_unique.name: vdd_active_series_unique
vdd_active_series_unique.where: "vertical_drama_draft_ledgers"."seriesId" IS NOT NULL AND "vertical_drama_draft_ledgers"."seriesDeletedAt" IS NULL AND "vertical_drama_draft_ledgers"."archivedAt" IS NULL

worker_job_events_assignment_sequence_un.name: worker_job_events_assignment_sequence_unique
worker_job_events_assignment_sequence_un.where: "assignmentId" IS NOT NULL AND "sequence" IS NOT NULL
